title: 20s Charleston Dance Tutorial - Full Choreography to the Song "Black Bottom"

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces the choreography structure, breaks down the steps into smaller sections (AABA), and demonstrates them slowly from the back view while explaining counts and body movements.
method.signature: Structuring the 1920s jazz routine into distinct musical parts with clear breakdowns and verbal count cues.

practices.what: The teacher introduces Part 1 (AABA) and starts breaking down the first A section into counts of 8.
The teacher demonstrates the Charleston basic steps facing backward while counting aloud from 1 to 8.
The teacher repeats the Charleston basic steps with arm swings to reinforce the movement.
The teacher adds hip bounces and slaps as the next element in the routine.
The teacher shows the off-beat timing for the slaps on counts 2, 4, 6, and 8.
The teacher moves on to the second A section, keeping the basic steps and adding clapping variations.
The teacher introduces the B part featuring kicks, shuffles, and a turn.
The teacher runs through the first A and second A sections together at a slow pace before moving forward.

beliefs.belief: Jumping into something new, discovering a dance style, and having fun is for everyone, regardless of prior experience.

moments.says: The teacher introduces herself and the breakdown of the Charleston dance choreography.
The teacher confirms the completion of the first part and transitions directly to the next section.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling encouraged and excited to explore a new vintage dance style at a slow pace.

struggles.theme: Trying to follow along and learn the difficult choreography at home

clicked.theme: Clear instructions and detailed step breakdowns made it possible to learn

requests.theme: Wants to see more dance tutorials and other dances on the channel

meant.theme: Brought immense joy, happiness, and inspiration to watch and learn

method.limits: The video provides a breakdown of the choreography without music during the instruction segments, which may require viewers to combine steps with the song separately.
